item.title: Take your Adblocker to go
item.description: If you’re like me, you have a deep distaste for the ads, trackers, and popups plaguing every website and app you use. Browser adblockers help on your laptop. But what about your phone? Your tablet? Your family’s devices? In this post, I’ll show you how to set up a free, self-hosted VPN and adblocker that works on all your devices, at home and on the go. You can even share it with friends and family.
